// config.ini records for the golden files (host/tests/config_golden.h): one record a line, each read as a whole
// config.ini (\n joins lines, \r \t \\ \xHH as in C). Every setting with each of its values, invalid ones, the removed
// features' lines, and the parser's own rules (comments, BOMs, spaces, a missing '=', lengths, order).
//
// ---- the parser's rules
; a comment
# a comment
   ; an indented comment
\t# a tabbed comment
bogus = 1
bogus line
Bogus_Setting = 1
key with spaces = 1
= value
 = value
==
